achievements.title: Winner, Code for Good — JPMorgan Chase
INMO Qualifier · RMO Top 30 Rank (2021) · Multiple mathematics competition wins

bullets.text: Built the authentication module on Better Auth for a template-driven marketplace platform (Shopify-style), implementing separate merchant and consumer auth planes with Postgres-backed sessions and accounts.

Engineered a real-time chat pipeline using a PostgreSQL transactional outbox, relay service, Centrifugo, and Redis, designed and tested against 25 failure and edge-case scenarios so messages are persisted atomically before delivery and not lost if the relay or broker restarts; built the React + Vite chat interface on top.

Helped build the internal admin dashboard in Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript, packaged as a standalone non-root container on a private GCP runtime; implemented the charts as hand-rolled SVG with no chart libraries, and used postgres for data access and jose for JWT verification.

Built an AI chatroom CLI for multi-agent planning: one shared Markdown transcript across a human and two agents (Claude in plan mode, Codex in a read-only sandbox), with explicit @claude/@codex/@both routing and no agent-to-agent loops.
Integrated Spring Boot backend services with React interfaces for an enterprise real estate platform, driving design decisions across distributed, multi-tiered systems.

Built Python batch pipelines with algorithmic validation and retry logic for scheduled data processing; containerized the workflow with Docker, cutting execution time from 240 min to 58 min (76% faster).

Automated database versioning and deployment via Liquibase and Jenkins CI/CD, and established containerized, tested release pipelines with Ansible and Playwright, improving deployment speed and release consistency across environments.

hero.headline: Building reliable software for backends, agents, and commerce.
hero.subline: I like creating software that stays up when everything else fails.
